Article 9 (Standards for Calculating Total Annual School Operating Expenses)
(1) The total annual school operating expenses under Article 10 (1) of the Decree shall be calculated by multiplying the student quota for the year in which enrollment is fully completed by the standard educational expenses per student determined annually by the Minister of Education with reference to the basic operating expenses of technical colleges. <Amended on February 2, 1999; January 31, 2001; March 4, 2008; March 23, 2013>
(2) Where the student quota is increased, the standard educational expenses per student used to calculate the additional total annual school operating expenses shall be the standard educational expenses per student for the year preceding the year in which the quota is increased.
